headline: 14 buses: BRTC launches women-only 'Pink Buses' in Dhaka, Bogura and Chattogram
summary: The new service features 10 buses on 10 routes in Dhaka and adjoining areas, with additional services in Bogura and Chattogram.
details: The Bangladesh Road Transport Corporation (BRTC) has launched a women-only 'Pink Bus' service. A total of 14 buses are being deployed, with 10 operating on 10 different routes in Dhaka and its adjoining areas, and two buses each in Bogura and Chattogram.
caption:
A safer commute for women! BRTC has launched 14 women-only 'Pink Buses' across Dhaka, Bogura, and Chattogram.

The Bangladesh Road Transport Corporation (BRTC) has launched a women-only 'Pink Bus' service. A total of 14 buses are being deployed, with 10 operating on 10 different routes in Dhaka and its adjoining areas, and two buses each in Bogura and Chattogram.

Source: Jamuna TV, The Daily Star

headline_marked: Historic win: [[Bangladesh beat Australia by 9 wickets]] in Darwin
headline: Historic win: Bangladesh beat Australia by 9 wickets in Darwin
summary: In their first Test on Australian soil in 23 years, the Tigers dominated the world's leading Test side, sparking a sell-out for the next match in Mackay.
details: Bangladesh achieved one of the biggest results in their cricketing history by defeating Australia by nine wickets in Darwin. The Tigers dominated the match for three and a half days, never allowing the hosts to regain control.

Australia was bowled out for 198 in their first innings, while Bangladesh responded with a massive 426. The hosts were then dismissed for 284 in their second innings, leaving Bangladesh to easily chase down a 57-run target.
The victory is particularly significant as Australia entered the series as the top-ranked side in the World Test Championship standings with their leading pace attack available.
This win challenges the long-held notion that Test cricket is dominated by a select group of established powers, marking a significant rise for Bangladesh in recent years.
The result has created massive excitement, leading to a sell-out of tickets for the opening day of the upcoming Test match in Mackay.

The victory also highlights the struggle for developing nations to get regular opportunities to play the best teams, as Bangladesh has faced scheduling and commercial hurdles in previous tours of Australia.
caption:
A historic first! 🇧🇩 Bangladesh just crushed the world's top Test side in Australia, winning by 9 wickets.

Bangladesh achieved one of the biggest results in their cricketing history by defeating Australia by nine wickets in Darwin. The Tigers dominated the match for three and a half days, never allowing the hosts to regain control.

Australia was bowled out for 198 in their first innings, while Bangladesh responded with a massive 426. The hosts were then dismissed for 284 in their second innings, leaving Bangladesh to easily chase down a 57-run target.

The victory is particularly significant as Australia entered the series as the top-ranked side in the World Test Championship standings with their leading pace attack available.

This win challenges the long-held notion that Test cricket is dominated by a select group of established powers, marking a significant rise for Bangladesh in recent years.

The result has created massive excitement, leading to a sell-out of tickets for the opening day of the upcoming Test match in Mackay.

The victory also highlights the struggle for developing nations to get regular opportunities to play the best teams, as Bangladesh has faced scheduling and commercial hurdles in previous tours of Australia.
